page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.c8a.16xlarge is a compute-optimized server instance built on x86_64 architecture and running under KVM virtualization. It is powered by AMD EPYC 9T24 processors operating at a base clock frequency of 2.7 GHz. The instance supplies 64 dedicated vCPUs without shared CPU credit limitations, delivering consistent execution capability across all cores for multi-threaded computing tasks.

System memory capacity total is 128.0 GB, providing a 1:2 memory-to-vCPU ratio equivalent to 2.0 GB of RAM per vCPU core. The server configuration includes no local NVMe storage and zero discrete GPUs. Data persistence requires remote network-attached block storage options. Network communication is backed by a 20 Gbps baseline network bandwidth profile.

The hardware configuration provides high compute density, offering qualitative cost efficiency for CPU-bound operations by eliminating non-essential local storage overhead while maintaining high dedicated core counts. Typical workload applications include heavy web application serving, continuous integration and deployment pipelines, multi-threaded software compilation, batch processing, and CPU-driven data transformation workloads.
